title: The Base-Rate Trap
music: sparse curious piano and soft synth pads, thoughtful, 80 bpm, no vocals

scenes.narration: A test for a rare disease is ninety nine percent accurate. You test positive. How worried should you be?
scenes.title: The Base-Rate Trap

scenes.narration: Picture a thousand people. Only one of them actually has the disease.
scenes.title: A Thousand People

scenes.narration: The test catches that one person. But a one percent error rate also flags about ten healthy people.
scenes.title: False Alarms

scenes.narration: So among everyone who tests positive, eleven people, only one is truly sick. That is about nine percent.
scenes.title: Do the Maths

scenes.narration: Accuracy describes the test. The base rate, how common the disease is, decides what a positive result means.
scenes.title: Two Different Numbers

scenes.narration: As the disease gets more common, the same positive test becomes far more convincing.
scenes.title: When Rates Change

scenes.narration: Before you trust a result, always ask how rare the thing really is.

content.text: Always ask how rare the thing really is.
